answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the glacier of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
